custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Click Fields to display, turn line technicians on and close the menu.
  4. Read the line technicians field on each of the three cards.
  5. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  6. Click the Column Selection button and make sure Assigned Techs is on (it is on by default; turn it on if it was turned off), then close the menu.
  7. Read the Assigned Techs cell for each of the three rows.
